{{Quote|On my homeworld, there are spiritual refuges for people to explore their natural talents and their faiths. It is a noble thing.|[[Prithi]]|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 12">[[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' (2013) 12]]</ref>}}
'''Chalacta''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Chalactan Adepts]].

==Description==
Chalacta was a pleasant world located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactans]], a well-known, baseline [[Human/Legends|Human]] culture,<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|118|Chalacta}}</ref> though were so distinct, that they were considered [[Near-Human]]s. Chalactan lived in small farms and cities and were very peaceful and spiritual. They were universally respected and known for the [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Chalactan Adepts]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|On the Mid Rim world of Chalacta, Senator Yudrish Sedran has consulted the Chalactan Temple of Illumination for direction, adopting a strong anti-Military Creation Act stance that has been anecdotally supported by Chalactan Jedi Depa Billaba and Sar Labooda.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="HNN55" />}}
Chalacta was once an uninhabited planet until it was colonized by the Chalactan Adepts.<ref name="FaDCR" />
[[File:Depa.jpg|thumb|right|130px|[[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]], a [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].]]
Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Chalactans were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yudrish Sedran/Legends|Yudrish Sedran]], who opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] after consulting the wisdom of the [[Temple of Illumination]].<ref name="HNN55" /> Chalacta was the homeworld of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]]<ref name="DB-Billaba">{{DB|character|depabillaba|Billaba, Depa}}</ref> and [[Sar Labooda/Legends|Sar Labooda]].<ref name="DB-Labooda">{{DB|character|sarlabooda|Labooda, Sar}}</ref>

<nowiki> </nowiki>During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Chalacta system|seized control]] of the world shortly after arriving in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />
